stalls.text: {{vendor_name}} has a folding table covered in batteries, wire, and things that spark when you least expect it. A hand-painted sign reads 'NO REFUNDS, NO EXCEPTIONS, NO TOUCHING.'

haggle.text: {{vendor_name}} doesn't yell, just names a price and taps the Sparky Bits until you agree. 'Two of these and a splash of fuel makes a knuckle-duster that bites back,' they say.

choices.label: Ask if there's something smaller, for a headache.

the_salts.text: 'One of these'll clear your sinuses instead, if you're into that,' {{vendor_name}} says, tossing over something that smells faintly of ozone.

choices.label: Ask what the ones that hum are for.

the_humming_box.text: {{vendor_name}} opens a box lined with foam and mutant cactus spines. 'Chew it with a live one in your cheek. You'll see farther for about ten seconds. After that it's your problem.'

static_shock.text: Something on the table was live. Your arm doesn't work right for a minute.

bad_wire.text: A wire you weren't supposed to touch finds your hand first. {{vendor_name}} doesn't apologize.
